cards.ko: 이 변화는 정말 오래 걸려서 이제야 이뤄졌어요.
cards.en: This change has been a long time coming.
cards.gram: a long time coming = 오래 걸려서 드디어 이뤄진(기다리던) 일. has been a long time coming 형태로 자주 써요.

cards.ko: 새 병원이 생긴 건 오래 기다려 온 일이에요.
cards.en: The new hospital in my town was a long time coming.
cards.gram: 좋은 일이 드디어 생겼을 때: It was a long time coming.

cards.ko: 좋아지는 줄 알았는데, 그건 잠깐의 착각이었어요.
cards.en: I thought things were getting better, but it was a false dawn.
cards.gram: false dawn = 좋아지는 것처럼 보였지만 실제로는 아닌 상황.

cards.ko: 다이어트 효과가 처음엔 좋아 보였지만 금방 끝났어요.
cards.en: My diet looked successful at first, but it was a false dawn.
cards.gram: it was a false dawn = 반짝하고 끝난 희망.

cards.en: There's a lot of new technology in the medical space.
cards.gram: space = (연구·사업) 분야. the medical space, the tech space.

cards.en: I want to work in the healthcare space.
cards.gram: in the + 분야 + space = ~ 분야에서. field와 같은 뜻으로 써요.

cards.ko: 과학자들이 암 치료에서 큰 돌파구를 찾았어요.
cards.en: Scientists have made a big breakthrough in cancer treatment.
cards.gram: make a breakthrough in ~ = ~에서 획기적인 진전을 이루다.

cards.ko: 영어 말하기에서 드디어 큰 발전이 있었어요.
cards.en: I finally had a breakthrough with my English speaking.
cards.gram: 개인적인 큰 발전에도 써요: have a breakthrough.

cards.ko: 백신은 우리 몸이 병과 싸울 준비를 시켜 줘요.
cards.en: Vaccines prime your body to fight diseases.

cards.ko: 시험 전에 아침을 먹으면 뇌가 준비돼요.
cards.en: Eating breakfast primes my brain before an exam.
This new treatment shows a lot of promise.
cards.gram: show promise = 가능성(잠재력)을 보이다. promise = 약속 말고 '가능성'.

cards.en: She shows great promise as a nurse.
cards.gram: show great promise as a + 직업 = ~로서 잠재력이 크다.
